Description:

Please join Subject Matter Expert(s) from the Army Contracting Command- Detroit Arsenal as we host Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO): 101 Training for Industry. Commercial Solutions Openings are a primary tool that ACC-DTA is using for agile acquisition and innovation. This event is being held on March 13, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM EST and is open to Industry, registration is required. The event will be held at the Velocity Event Center, located at 6633 18 Mile Road Sterling Heights, MI 48314.

Formal registration is required.

Event Agenda:

0730- Registration

0800- Opening Remarks / Ground Rules

0815- CSO 101 Training Begins

1200- Event Concludes

Participants

Industry representatives, including both established and emerging companies. Organizations with limited government contracting experience are welcome.

RSVP is required no later than 5:00 p.m. EDT on March 12, 2026, at the following link.

https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/B3R2eT7tu6
